title: Co-transcriptional folding orchestrates sequential multi-effector sensing by a glycine tandem riboswitch.
authors: Romero, Rosa A; Chauvier, Adrien; Teh, Serena S; Reed, Vincent A; Zhang, Sicheng; Szyjka, Courtney E; Chen, Shi-Jie; Strobel, Eric J; Walter, Nils G
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核糖开关共转录折叠与配体传感，虽涉及RNA结构建模和转录因子NusA，但核心是RNA-配体互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Riboswitches are non-coding RNA motifs that regulate gene expression in response to ligand binding. The glycine tandem riboswitch (GTR) is notable because it comprises two distinct glycine aptamers that interact extensively. These inter-aptamer contacts drive conformational changes in the downstream expression platform to control gene expression. Despite extensive studies, the role of glycine and RNA folding pathways in co-transcriptional regulation remains unclear. Here, we integrate single-molecule kinetic analysis, co-transcriptional RNA structure probing, and computational modeling to reveal that the GTR processes multiple molecular inputs sequentially, guided by polymerase pausing. Our findings elucidate its stepwise 5'-to-3' folding pathway and demonstrate how sequential glycine binding to each aptamer, K(+) binding to a kink-turn, non-native RNA folding intermediates, inter-aptamer docking that drives binding site pre-organization, and modulation by the transcription factor NusA collectively orchestrate co-transcriptional gene regulation. These results support a model in which glycine binding cooperativity arises through non-equilibrium mechanisms rather than a classical concerted model.
abstract_zh: 核糖开关（riboswitch）是非编码RNA基序，通过响应配体结合来调控基因表达。甘氨酸串联核糖开关（GTR）因其包含两个相互作用广泛的独立甘氨酸适配体而引人注目。这些适配体间的接触驱动下游表达平台的构象变化，从而控制基因表达。尽管已有大量研究，甘氨酸和RNA折叠途径在共转录调控中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们整合单分子动力学分析、共转录RNA结构探测和计算建模，揭示GTR在聚合酶暂停的引导下顺序处理多个分子输入。我们的发现阐明了其从5'到3'的逐步折叠途径，并展示了甘氨酸对每个适配体的顺序结合、K(+)与扭结转角（kink-turn）的结合、非天然RNA折叠中间体、驱动结合位点预组织的适配体间对接，以及转录因子NusA的调节如何共同协调共转录基因调控。这些结果支持一个模型，即甘氨酸结合协同性通过非平衡机制产生，而非经典的协同模型。
